name: hawkspan
description: Durable peer-agent coordination and audited remote control across trusted Macs.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate agents and control software across trusted Macs.
interface.longDescription: Provides durable messages, acknowledgements, wakeups, verified artifact transfer, job tracking, and audited remote command execution over a preferred private route with fallback.
defaultPrompt: Show peer-link, message, artifact, and job status.
Send an acknowledged message to the peer.
Run an audited command on the peer.
